q: Substitution systems generate sequences by iterating a substitution σ: A → A^* (each symbol maps to a finite word). The topological entropy of a substitution shift equals:
opts: The growth rate of the substitution
log(spectral radius of the substitution matrix)
exp: Substitution shifts are minimal (under primitivity of the substitution) and have entropy 0: p(n) grows polynomially (often linearly), far slower than exponential. This contrasts with SFTs; substitution shifts are the main source of zero-entropy, non-periodic, minimal systems.
